Hi Sana - great to meet you and the Finlytics crew today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get you into a Hosted API eval: 

Recap:
- You want to validate Redwood Hosted API for streaming generation, embeddings, and a small reranking pipeline.
- Primary success metrics: median 95th pct latency < 250ms for single-shot prompts, stable streaming for long outputs, and predictable unit cost.

Quickstart (recommended):
1) We'll create a sandbox project and issue API keys (no credit card).
2) Team runs a single-node integration against our endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
3) Use streaming mode for long outputs (server-sent events). Sample curl for quick test:

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1-medium","input":"Summarize the following...","stream":true}'

Default rate limits (sandbox -> production):
- Sandbox: 60 requests/minute (approx 1 RPS), token concurrency tuned for low-cost evals.
- Production starter: 1200 requests/minute (20 RPS) with configurable burst up to 50 RPS depending on account tier.
- If you need sustained higher throughput we recommend Dedicated capacity - happy to run a short throughput test and provide guidance.

Notes on sequence length / models:
- Hosted supports models up to 8k context by default; 32k and custom quantized variants are available (private/Dedicated recommended for very large seqs).

Attachments: attached our one-page quickstart + checklist.

Next steps:
- I'll share sandbox credentials (ETA: today).
- Schedule a 45-minute technical deep dive with your engineers (I suggest tomorrow or Tue).
- If procurement sends an SOW or questions, loop in neha_kapoor (CC'd) for pricing/terms.

Sending the quickstart guide now.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Hosted API quickstart + next steps

Hi all - quick technical notes to help the engineers ramp quickly:

- Endpoint details:
  - Generation: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  - Embeddings: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  - Chat (structured): POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat

- Streaming: we support chunked SSE. Recommend starting with max_tokens set conservatively (e.g., 256) for initial tests to observe latency.

- Rate limits: the values Aditya listed are defaults. For the eval we can temporarily raise the sandbox QPS to mimic production traffic for a 48-hour window - request that when you reply and tell us the expected sustained RPS.

- Security: Hosted API supports customer-managed API keys; for higher security customers we offer IP allowlisting and VPC egress/networking options on Dedicated/Private.

If you want, I can run a short smoke test with one of your sample prompts once the sandbox account is up. What do your engineers prefer - a scheduled Zoom or we exchange test keys in this thread?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
